source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
For growing a paddy field crop intended for pure seed production, choose a field close to a reliable water source, and preferably in an area set apart from villages, to avoid disturbance from grazing livestock and to avoid accumulating runoff water flowing in from other fields. The field should have evenly good soil fertility and a field boundary (bund) with clearly visible, well-defined edges.

Do not select a field with standing weed growth that would receive or channel runoff or flood water from streams or canals into the plot. Where a seed-production field borders another field planted with a different rice variety, the separating bund/dyke between them must be built wide, about 3-5 meters, to prevent seed or pollen mixing between the two varieties.

Proper land preparation of the paddy field is essential: it is necessary to prepare (till/plow) the field 2-3 times so the field surface is well leveled. This facilitates even growth of the rice crop and allows farmers to eliminate weeds beforehand, before transplanting or sowing.
